description: Update an existing calendar's properties (display name, description, color, timezone). Use this when user asks to "rename calendar", "change calendar color", or "update calendar properties"

calendar_url.description: The URL of the calendar to update (get from list_calendars)

color.description: Optional: New calendar color in hex format (e.g., #FF5733)

description.description: Optional: New description for the calendar

display_name.description: Optional: New display name for the calendar

timezone.description: Optional: New timezone ID (e.g., Europe/Berlin). Sent to the server as a bare timezone ID, not as the VTIMEZONE the CalDAV standard asks for, so a server may reject or ignore it (issue #78).

name: update_calendar
